question: The Hirakud Dam project is a multipurpose scheme intended for flood control, irrigation and power generation. It is built across ______ river.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahanadi River**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Hirakud Dam** is a multipurpose dam built across the **Mahanadi River** in the state of **Odisha, India**.
 
• The dam is situated about **15 km upstream of Sambalpur** and is one of the longest earthen dams in the world, with a total length of 25.8 km, including the dykes.
 
• It was constructed with the primary objectives of **flood control**, providing **irrigation** to agricultural lands, and generating **hydroelectric power**.
 
• The dam was inaugurated by the then Prime Minister of India, **Jawaharlal Nehru**, in **1957**.
 
• The Hirakud Dam reservoir has a capacity of about **5.818 cubic kilometers** and provides irrigation to an area of over **436,000 hectares**.
